problem: The protected website browser lane repeatedly failed while clicking the homepage Platform/Expertise tabs because sticky shell elements and a floating aside intercepted the pointer after automatic scrolling.
root_cause: The browser contract relied on Playwright's default scroll-to-click behavior while the page still had moving/sticky geometry. That could position the target underneath the fixed header or floating UI even though the tab itself remained valid.
decision: Preserve a real physical click but make it deterministic: center the tab in the viewport, allow layout to settle, retry at most three times, and never use force-click.
prevention: Homepage toggle browser checks center the target before every physical click.
Retries are bounded to three attempts with short stabilization delays.
force:true is prohibited so genuine overlay/interactability defects still fail closed.
